result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred monetary cap and retains a mutual cap. Based on the stated existing scope of “Excluded Claims,” it also preserves the required uncapped carve-outs, thereby at least satisfying the fallback position. It does not fully achieve the preferred position because it adds neither a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages nor clarification that Customer payment obligations are not damages subject to the cap. The amendment is otherwise targeted and professionally drafted, though “under this Agreement and all Order Forms” is slightly redundant and “all amounts” is broader than “fees.”
